applies_why: The judge text grounds an UNDERDETERMINED result on Matthew 1:16 admitting two readings.
quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- the passive egennēthē (was born) with feminine hēs (of whom) admits both the withheld-father and the birth-narration readings
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open: either dual sense forbids UNDERDETERMINED, or dual sense may support UNDERDETERMINED; the rule's next sentence favors the first reading.
why: The judge made the verse's two admitted readings a ground for UNDERDETERMINED, but K-S2 says a verse carrying two senses at once is not open and both senses stand.
